result.reason: The operative language satisfies the frequency, notice, business-hours, independent-auditor, confidentiality, and no-system-access requirements, but it does not state the required cost allocation: Vendor must bear audit costs unless the applicable underpayment threshold is exceeded. The margin comment’s unsupported reference to Section 22.2 cannot cure that omission. The redline also adds protections not required by the playbook, including the competitor restriction and operational-disruption standard, so it is not strictly minimal, although it preserves Vendor’s underlying audit right and is otherwise professionally drafted.
